closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, practical staple food, and fairly filling, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, energy, and low-calorie volume because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, the carb section gives it a clear fuel role, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
